messages:
Jenna (AE): FYI ACME ran their security questionnaire and procurement sent a list of blockers. They require domain proof beyond tenant email, clarity on SCIM delta vs full sync (esp deletes), Okta group -> role mapping detail, SAML attribute mapping, and whether higher SCIM throughput changes the POC pricing. They want a 2-week hands-on POC. @Sam @Tara can you chime in?

Sam (SE): Short answers to send them now:
- Domain proof options: DNS TXT verification or admin email, and for enterprise we can enable tenant-locking which requires DNS TXT + org admin consent.
- SAML: full SAML 2.0 support (IdP/SP initiated). We expose a configurable attribute map so customers can map assertion attributes to Redwood role claims.
- SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0 with incremental sync via filtering (If-Modified-Since) and pagination params. We return tombstones via `active:false` and include `meta.lastModified`. Default page size is 100; pagination controlled via `startIndex`/`count`.
- Deletions: soft-deletes are indicated with `active:false` and retained as tombstones for 7 days by default; hard deletes supported on request.
- Rate limits: hosted defaults are conservative (30 req/s). For Dedicated or short POC pools we can raise to ~200 req/s and allow short bursts.
- RBAC: Okta group -> Redwood role mapping configurable at tenant scope; support multiple group-to-role entries and precedence rules.
- Example SCIM call: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=100"`

Tara (Security): Security notes to hand the customer:
- TLS 1.2+ for in-transit, mTLS available for private deployments.
- At-rest encryption for credentials and cache; keys managed in KMS/HSM.
- Audit logs with token-level tracing; retention per contract.
- We can supply SOC 2 Type II report, DPA, and subprocessor list. Need to confirm EU vs US data residency.
- Cert rotation: we support a 7-day overlap window and IdP cert fingerprint checks.

Michael (Legal): Send me any DPA edits and I'll review same day. Also confirm whether SCIM will include PII beyond email/name (e.g., manager, location) since that affects DPA scoping. If they ask for custom log retention or export controls, flag now.

Ravi (ACME IT): We'll initially send name/email/employee-id only. Later we may add manager and location. We need SSO role elevation by Okta groups. Procurement asked if higher SCIM rates during POC will change the quoted price.

Priya (PM): POC options:
- Option A: Short-lived Dedicated POC pool (isolated infra, higher rate limits) for 2 weeks. Requires sales approval for budget.
- Option B: Hosted with temporary rate raise and SAC window. Cheaper but limited isolation.
- POC checklist: test tenant, IdP metadata, SCIM token, sample CSV of users, and security questionnaire PDF.

Jenna (AE): @Sam please confirm exact delta semantics to tell ACME (they specifically want details on soft-delete behavior). Also need a ballpark uplift for a 2-week Dedicated POC for procurement quote.

Sam (SE): Soft-delete specifics: we set `active:false` and emit a tombstone entry with `meta.lastModified`. Tombstones retained 7 days by default to allow downstream reconciliation; we can extend retention on request. Hard-delete can be triggered but we recommend it only after downstream systems are reconciled.

Pricing ballpark (tentative):
- Dedicated 2-week POC with reserved GPUs + boosted SCIM throughput: $5k-$8k depending on GPU class and SLA.
- Hosted with burst window and raised rate limits: $1k-$1.5k (manual support approval required).
These are draft numbers — finance to confirm.

Tara (Security): I'll draft a one-page security summary (SOC2 link, DPA, cert rotation, encryption, audit logs) to hand to ACME. Jenna drop the questionnaire here and I'll fill it. :thumbsup:

Jenna (AE): Uploading questionnaire to SFDC and thread (internal link): https://redwood.sfdc/opp/ACME-12345/qna

Michael (Legal): After I see their DPA redlines I can turn around comments same day. If they require EU-only processing we need a follow-up call about private deployment architecture.

Ravi (ACME IT): Can we do a technical kickoff this Friday? Need engineering + security on the call.

Jenna (AE): Friday morning works. @Sam @Tara pls confirm. Action items: 1) Sam: firm throughput & pricing quote, 2) Tara: security summary, 3) Michael: DPA turnaround estimate, 4) Jenna: schedule kickoff + send POC checklist.

Sam (SE): Confirmed Friday morning; I'll demo SCIM deltas and role mapping.

Tara (Security): Confirmed.

Jenna (AE): Thanks team, moving to calendar. :rocket:
